premise: Maya decides the booster swinging its legs up on the pad is doing its morning stretches, so she joins in — and the buggy spins its wheels as if it were pedalling along.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Monkey and the Camel', where copying a dancer ends badly, turned: copying the booster isn't foolish at all — it's the Moon's first exercise class.

en-US.title: Morning Stretches
en-US.text: Every morning, {woman:enter} Maya did her stretches out on the plain. {woman:hop} Reach up! Touch your toes! This morning she had company. On the landing pad stood the tall {booster:enter} {booster:go to pad} booster, waiting for its next flight. Slowly, {booster:live hold} it swung its four landing legs halfway up… and held them there. {sfx:whirr} {woman:face surprised} [gasps] Maya stared. {woman:says} “Are you… stretching?” [playfully] {woman:face happy} Well, if a booster could stretch, so could she. Up went one leg. {woman:wobble} Wobble, wobble. {booster:live resume} Down came the booster's legs, slow and steady. {woman:hop} Down came Maya's. Then the {buggy:enter} buggy came rolling over to join in. {buggy:live} It spun its wheels round and round, right where it stood, as if it were pedalling a bicycle. [laughs] {woman:wobble x2} Maya laughed so hard she sat down in the dust. {woman:dust-puff} {booster:pulse} {buggy:hop} [happily] And that was the very first exercise class on the Moon.

es-ES.title: Estiramientos de buena mañana
es-ES.text: Cada mañana, {woman:enter} Maya hacía sus estiramientos en la llanura. {woman:hop} ¡Brazos arriba! ¡Tocarse los pies! Esta mañana tenía compañía. En la plataforma de aterrizaje esperaba el alto {booster:enter} {booster:go to pad} cohete propulsor, listo para su próximo vuelo. Despacio, {booster:live hold} levantó sus cuatro patas hasta la mitad… y las dejó ahí. {sfx:whirr} {woman:face surprised} [gasps] Maya lo miró. {woman:says} «¿Estás… estirando?» [playfully] {woman:face happy} Pues si un cohete podía estirarse, ella también. Arriba una pierna. {woman:wobble} Tambaleo, tambaleo. {booster:live resume} Bajaron las patas del cohete, despacio y firmes. {woman:hop} Bajaron las de Maya. Entonces llegó el {buggy:enter} buggy para apuntarse. {buggy:live} Giró las ruedas sin moverse del sitio, como si pedaleara en una bicicleta. [laughs] {woman:wobble x2} Maya se rió tanto que se sentó en el polvo. {woman:dust-puff} {booster:pulse} {buggy:hop} [happily] Y esa fue la primera clase de gimnasia de la Luna.
